manifest.method: For each named tokenizer (tiktoken 0.13.0), compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) per fixed pair and take the arithmetic mean over eight pairs. Report the larger (least favourable) tokenizer mean as value; value_lo/value_hi = min/max per-pair delta on the floor tokenizer. English arms are the ratified mapping's own canonical phrase ', measured against baseline B'; ainglish arms are the identical sentence with the clause replaced by ' vs(B)'. Local deterministic count.
